text:
Matthew Wood was traded from Nashville to Seattle for Shane Wright on Nov. 1, and his first weeks as a Kraken have been a grind. He has one goal and six points in 20 games this season, none in his last 16, on 2.5 expected goals over that stretch (expected goals measure the quality of chances).

That is a slump, not a collapse. He has one goal on 3.7 expected for the season, and goals tend to follow chances. Evolving-Hockey had him 110th among 401 forwards as a rookie last season, worth 1.4 wins, mostly from even-strength offense, and he scored 17 goals. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him in the 83rd percentile for primary shot assists. For context, of the 100 forwards picked 10th to 20th from 2005 to 2024 with four-plus seasons, 76 reached 200 NHL games. The 15th overall pick of 2023 is 21. Our range has him around 12 goals. One goal for his new team would help.
